title: The Shepherd's Tally
subtitle: A statistic, and a reward behind an advancement
description: The task is a statistic — eight animals bred — and the reward is gated on the advancement for breeding one, which is the belt-and-braces version of the same question. A reward's conditions are checked on every path that pays it, and a reward whose conditions are unmet is not lost: it waits, unclaimed, for the day they hold.
The reward's condition is an advancement condition; the task beside it could have carried one too, and the manual's page on conditions says when each belongs.
